verdict.rationale: Docs show reviews can be triggered on demand by commenting `cursor review` or `bugbot run`, and repository scope can be limited to selected repositories. Community evidence indicates automatic reviews can be turned off in favor of on-request runs. However, automatic mode runs on every PR update, and nothing documents skipping drafts or filtering by branch or label. Missing for 10: draft-PR skipping, branch-based filtering, label-based triggering/filtering, first-party documentation of the auto-review on/off toggle.
